lead_independence.headline: Martin County judge imposes effective life sentence in AI child exploitation case
lead_independence.lead: Martin County Judge Elizabeth Metzger imposed a prison sentence effectively equal to life on Daniel Warren for using artificial intelligence to create child sexual abuse material. Warren used covert photos of neighborhood children to generate sexualized images that he shared with others, prosecutor Kristen Chase said.

source_focus.source_title: Martin County man sentenced to 84 years in child pornography, voyeurism case - cw34.com
source_focus.source_lead: Daniel Clark Warren was sentenced to more than 84 years in prison after being found guilty on 82 counts, including possessing child sexual abuse material and video voyeurism involving a minor, according to court records. Warren was adjudicated guilty on all counts Wednesday in Martin County .
